thread:
sam: quick check — planning to flip v2 stable for text/generate next week. owners: tess for server, devon for SDK. any blockers?

tess: server's mostly ready, but i want to keep a tiny compat shim for v1 clients. i'll land a header-based fallback by EOD tomorrow.

devon: SDK has one failing integration test around streaming fallback (empty-chunk handling). reproducing locally, PR incoming. ETA today.

anya: support flagged a customer on v1 with custom auth — they requested a 2-week migration window and step-by-step docs. pls account for that.

sam: good call. can we pin a rollback/runbook? if toggle misbehaves, infra will revert route. @deploy-bot can you schedule a small canary (5%) for Tue 10:00 PT?

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: service=api-gateway target=v2 route=stable traffic=5% start=2025-06-10T17:00:00Z. Will post rollout events and health checks.

devon: PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/412 — adds streaming fallback + compat header parsing. tests pass locally; CI flaky on macos runner.

ci-bot: CI: sdk/pull/412 — build=failed (macos-runner). Rerun with `ci rerun 412` to trigger macOS job.

tess: on server side i'll honor `X-Redwood-Compat: v1` and keep v1 semantics for token TTL and trailing-empty-chunk behavior for 14 days after flip. also adding a metric `compat.v1_requests` for visibility.

sam: plan outline: canary Tue 10:00 PT (5%, 4h monitoring), 25% Wed, 100% Thu if clean. docs + support templates by Wed AM. tess/devon own rollout; anya owns support comms.

anya: noted — i'll draft the support template and migration steps, will put a draft in #customer-success for review by Wed 09:00 PT.

sam: final asks before flip: devon add release-notes entry about streaming behavior change; tess add the `compat.v1_requests` dashboard and an alert for error-rate>1%. last quick ping from me before we flip.
